comment: Sustainability is assessed against 'whole-of-life cost and viability — to build, operate, maintain, and evolve'. Where a capability depends on external model inference, a material part of that whole-of-life cost is a per-unit price set by a third party, revisable unilaterally, and denominated in a foreign currency — a cost structure that scales with clinical volume rather than with the country's budget cycle, and that has no analogue among the other components described. Model deprecation carries the same character: a capability can be withdrawn or materially altered on a supplier's schedule.
